---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
billboard_long <- tidyr::billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(rank))

top_tracks <- billboard_long |>
  count(track, sort = TRUE) |>
  slice_head(n = 12) |>
  pull(track)

billboard_long |>
  filter(track %in% top_tracks) |>
  mutate(track = factor(track, levels = top_tracks)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track, group = track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(vars(track), ncol = 3) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 10, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100)) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo", guide = "none") +
  labs(
    title = "The Longest-Running Billboard Hits",
    subtitle = "Weekly chart rank for the 12 longest-running songs",
    x = "Week on the chart",
    y = "Billboard rank"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines")
  )
```
